title: Encoding text and decoding bytes
description: You can follow the same greeting through two representations.

steps.description: text holds a Python string. You will convert that string using the explicitly named UTF-8 encoding.
encode returns bytes in encoded_text. The printed representation begins with b to identify that bytes value.

steps.question: What representation does decode return from these UTF-8 bytes?
steps.answer: It returns a Python string containing the original greeting.

steps.description: You see the greeting printed again without the bytes prefix. Both conversions use UTF-8, completing this text-to-bytes round trip.
